main.description: Grant an OAuth client access to a space, creating the space's appAccess allow-list if this is its first grant. Caller must have the manager role on the space. The grant record is owned by the org repo within its governing space.

clientId.description: The OAuth client_id (client metadata document URL) to grant access to.

uri.description: URI of the written appAccess record.

errors.name: InvalidClientId
errors.description: clientId is not a valid OAuth client_id URL, or is too long to address as a record key.
